mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital and stimulates equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 5.5% indicates a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.5%, or the rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is above its 2017 base (100) and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 6.0%, it signals a robust economic expansion that supports positive equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO > 100 and UNRATE < 6.0%, or the rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (CPIAUCSL > 255 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%), the Federal Reserve is likely to tighten monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 255 and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1500 thousand units, it signals a weakening housing market and reduced consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 1500, or the rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL increase above 260 signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to consider rate hikes, which leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 260, or the rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 2017 base (100) indicates a weakening manufacturing sector and potential recession, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or the rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1500 thousand units and retail sales (RSAFS) exceed 550000 million dollars, it signals robust consumer spending and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 1500 and RSAFS > 550000, or the rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03
